entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The post-festival party is finally over.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It turned out to be more like[n]an interview party, huh?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I still can't believe you said that...
entries.uk: Досі не віриться, що ти таке сказав...

entries.en: You were in trouble.[clr 27]
I couldn't ignore you.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Right...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: At any rate... I'm not sure what[n]I would have done without you.
entries.uk: У всякому разі... не знаю, що б я[n]робила без тебе.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank you for saving me.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You're a mysterious person,[n]but you're so reliable.
entries.uk: Ти загадкова людина,[n]але на тебе так можна покластися.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I think the two of us will get along[n]quite well in the future...
entries.uk: Думаю, у майбутньому ми з тобою[n]чудово порозуміємося...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *giggle* As they say.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Who knows what may lie ahead.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: For now, I'm worried about what[n]happened with Akechi-kun...
entries.uk: А поки мене турбує те, що сталося[n]з Акечі...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But I have to say, my first[n]post-festival party was quite fun.[n]Though... I guess it's my last too.
entries.uk: Але мушу сказати, моя перша вечірка[n]після фестивалю була дуже веселою.[n]Хоча... мабуть, і остання.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Here, I'd like you to have this.
entries.uk: Ось, я хочу, щоб це було в тебе.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I... bought it earlier...
It looks delicious.[clr 27]
I can't wait to eat it.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *giggle*

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Now then, let's go home.
